url.title: URL
url.description: The URL that was looked up, as resolved from the input (scheme added if missing).

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The bare domain, with scheme and path stripped.

technologies.title: Technologies
technologies.description: Every detected technology, with category, version (if include_versions is on) and confidence score (if include_confidence is on).

techNames.title: Technology names
techNames.description: Flat list of detected technology names, for quick scanning without unpacking the technologies array.

techCount.title: Technology count
techCount.description: Number of technologies detected on this domain, after any categories_filter is applied.

dns.title: DNS records
dns.description: Resolved A, AAAA, CNAME and NS records. Carries its own error field if DNS resolution failed for this domain.

cdn.title: CDN
cdn.description: Detected content delivery network, when one was identified. Omitted from the row entirely when no CDN was detected.

tls.title: TLS certificate
tls.description: Certificate issuer, subject and expiry read from the TLS handshake on port 443. Omitted from the row entirely when the domain has no HTTPS. Carries its own error field if the handshake failed.

example.issuer: DigiCert Global G3 TLS ECC SHA384 2020 CA1
example.subject: stripe.com

mail.title: Mail provider
mail.description: MX records and the guessed mail provider. Carries its own error field if MX lookup failed for this domain.

httpStatus.title: HTTP status
httpStatus.description: Status code returned by the one homepage GET request. Omitted from the row entirely when the request never completed.

charged.title: Charged
charged.description: Whether this row's lookup was billed under pay-per-event. Always false while the Actor has no price set.

error.title: Error
error.description: Set when the input entry could not be turned into a usable domain at all. Per-lookup failures (DNS/TLS/mail) instead live in dns.error / tls.error / mail.error so the rest of the row still comes back populated.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per domain: what was detected plus the infrastructure fields the incumbent doesn't report.
